You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0117.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
import numpy as np
rw=Chem.RWMol()
elements=['C','C','C','C','O','N','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','O','N','C','C','C','C','C','C']
for e in elements: rw.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(e))
for i,j in [(0,1),(0,5),(0,9),(0,16),(1,2),(2,3),(3,5),(5,6),(6,7),(7,8),(8,9),(9,10),(10,11),(9,12),(12,13),(13,14),(14,16),(16,17),(18,1)]: rw.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
for i,j in [(3,4),(14,15)]: rw.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE)
for i,j in [(17,18),(18,19),(19,20),(20,21),(21,22),(22,17)]: rw.AddBond(i,j,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
m=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(m); m=Chem.AddHs(m)
xy=[(341,338),(218,338),(165,245),(249,166),(233,50),(341,222),(425,134),(525,154),(546,254),(460,338),(575,338),(675,338),(546,422),(525,522),(425,541),(379,637),(341,467),(249,513),(166,432),(53,462),(21,575),(106,657),(219,626)]
cf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms()); cf.Set3D(False)
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(xy): cf.SetAtomPosition(i,(x/100,-y/100,0))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetAtomicNum()==1:
  p=cf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetNeighbors()[0].GetIdx()); cf.SetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx(),(p.x,p.y+0.5,0))
h=[n.GetIdx() for n in m.GetAtomWithIdx(1).GetNeighbors() if n.GetAtomicNum()==1][0]
cf.SetAtomPosition(h,(1.0,-3.38,0))
m.AddConformer(cf)
print('left H idx',h)
for a,b in [(1,h),(9,10)]:
 bond=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a,b)
 assert bond.GetBeginAtomIdx()==a
 bond.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('Formula:',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
print('SMILES:',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
for i in [0,1,9]:
 a=m.GetAtomWithIdx(i); print(i,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-')
for b in m.GetBonds(): b.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.NONE)
m.RemoveAllConformers()
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=117; params.numThreads=4; params.pruneRmsThresh=0.15; params.maxIterations=3000
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=100,params=params)
print('Embedded:',len(ids),flush=True)
results=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m,numThreads=4,maxIters=2500)
rank=sorted((res[1],cid,res[0]) for cid,res in zip(ids,results))
print('rank',rank[:20])
if not rank: raise RuntimeError('No conformers')
energy,cid,status=rank[0]
Chem.MolToXYZFile(m,'answer.xyz',confId=cid)
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'answer.mol',confId=cid)
import pickle
with open('conformers.pkl','wb') as f: pickle.dump((m,rank),f)
# Confirm conformational chirality against tagged desired centers.
test=Chem.Mol(m); Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(test,confId=cid,replaceExistingTags=True); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(test,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for i in [0,1,9]:
 a=test.GetAtomWithIdx(i); print('geometry stereo',i,a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '-')
print('Saved atom count',m.GetNumAtoms())
PY
python build.py
which xtb || true; head -8 answer.xyz; ls -l answer.xyz
mkdir -p xtb_run; cp answer.xyz xtb_run/input.xyz; cd xtb_run; OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 xtb input.xyz --gfn 2 --opt tight > xtb.log 2>&1; tail -20 xtb.log
ls xtb_run; tail -25 xtb_run/xtb.log; pgrep -af xtb | head

from rdkit import Chem
m,rank=pickle.load(open('conformers.pkl','rb'))
for E,cid,status in rank[:15]:
 t=Chem.Mol(m); Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(t,confId=cid,replaceExistingTags=True); Chem.AssignStereochemistry(t,cleanIt=True,force=True)
 print(round(E,4),tuple(t.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode') for i in (0,1,9)))

cat > finalize.py <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import pickle
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import rdDetermineBonds
import numpy as np
p=Path('xtb_run/xtbopt.xyz')
assert p.exists()
m,rank=pickle.load(open('conformers.pkl','rb'))
lines=p.read_text().splitlines(); n=int(lines[0]); assert n==m.GetNumAtoms()
cf=Chem.Conformer(n)
for i,line in enumerate(lines[2:2+n]):
 a,x,y,z=line.split(); assert a==m.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetSymbol()
 cf.SetAtomPosition(i,(float(x),float(y),float(z)))
m.RemoveAllConformers(); m.AddConformer(cf)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
assert m.GetAtomWithIdx(1).GetProp('_CIPCode')=='S'
assert m.GetAtomWithIdx(9).GetProp('_CIPCode')=='R'
# Check all expected bonded pairs have chemically reasonable distances.
xyz=np.array(cf.GetPositions())
for b in m.GetBonds():
 i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx(); d=np.linalg.norm(xyz[i]-xyz[j]);
 assert 0.85<d<1.85,(i,j,d)
lines[1]='C19H22N2O2; stereochemistry from mol_0117.png; GFN2-xTB optimized; angstrom'
Path('answer.xyz').write_text('\n'.join(lines[:2+n])+'\n')
print('Validated answer.xyz:',n,'atoms, all hydrogens explicit.')
PY
sleep 10; tail -10 xtb_run/xtb.log; test -f xtb_run/xtbopt.xyz && python finalize.py || true

PY
sleep 15; tail -15 xtb_run/xtb.log; if [ -f xtb_run/xtbopt.xyz ]; then python finalize.py; fi
